body.name: Xprime
body.def: For \((H'_{n,s},z'_{n1s})\in\Omega_{n,1s}(\rho)\), let \(G'_s=\{1,\ldots,N_{n1s}\}\setminus H'_{n,s}\), \(g_s^{\prime z}=\sum_{i\in G'_s}\mathbf 1\{z'_{n1si}=z\}\), \(\bar Y_{G,s}^{\prime z}=(g_s^{\prime z})^{-1}\sum_{i\in G'_s}\mathbf 1\{z'_{n1si}=z\}\widetilde Y^{0,\mathcal D(\rho)}_{n1si}\), and \(s_{G,s}^{\prime2,z}=(g_s^{\prime z}-1)^{-1}\sum_{i\in G'_s}\mathbf 1\{z'_{n1si}=z\}(\widetilde Y^{0,\mathcal D(\rho)}_{n1si}-\bar Y_{G,s}^{\prime z})^2\). If \(g_s^{\prime0},g_s^{\prime1}\ge2\) and \(\widehat v_{ns}^{X\prime}=s_{G,s}^{\prime2,1}/g_s^{\prime1}+s_{G,s}^{\prime2,0}/g_s^{\prime0}>0\), set \(X'_{n,s}=(\bar Y_{G,s}^{\prime1}-\bar Y_{G,s}^{\prime0})/\sqrt{\widehat v_{ns}^{X\prime}}\); otherwise set \(X'_{n,s}=c_s-1\).
body.role: Fisher-completed selector recomputed for every stage-1 candidate
